root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from using `list_del_init()` instead of `list_del_rcu()` in `rxrpc_put_call()` to remove entries from the `rxnet->calls` list, which breaks RCU-safe iteration and causes infinite loops when reading `/proc/net/rxrpc/calls`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `net/rxrpc/call_object.c` to replace `list_del_init(&call->link)` with `list_del_rcu(&call->link)` in `rxrpc_put_call()`, and the commit message explicitly states this change prevents infinite loops when reading `/proc/net/rxrpc/calls`.
